name: erp-process-transformation-agent
description: Evidence-backed, vendor-neutral ERP transformation suite for process diagnostics, innovation opportunities, internal benchmarking, and decision-ready portfolios.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-backed ERP diagnostics, innovation opportunities, and decision-ready portfolios.
interface.longDescription: Turns supplied ERP process evidence into traceable findings, bounded innovation opportunities, comparable internal benchmarks, initiative portfolios, and proof-of-value reviews. It distinguishes facts, observations, hypotheses, and assumptions; it does not provide unsupported savings or compliance assurances.
defaultPrompt: Identify evidence-backed innovation opportunities from our supplied ERP process evidence; state the lens, metric, guardrails, owner, kill condition, and next validation.
Run a rapid O2C diagnostic from our supplied process evidence; separate facts from hypotheses and identify the minimum validation evidence.
Create an O2C deep dive with process friction, control, data, and standardization opportunities backed by the supplied evidence.
Build a comparable internal benchmark across our entities using only the supplied evidence, cohort rules, coverage, and confidence.
Turn validated ERP findings and innovation opportunities into an initiative portfolio with owners, dependencies, risks, KPIs, and decision status.
Map the evidence-backed blast radius of this proposed ERP process change and define an exit strategy with supplied dependencies, guardrails, owner, validation, and exit criterion.
